name: (05) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 3 Advanced — Leech of Fear

system.description:
As demons feed on stranger fare than blood, so the infernalist learns to drink a victim's terror, drawing sustenance from raw fear as if it were vitae.

You may use this power on a given individual once per night. They must be within your line of sight and genuinely afraid of or intimidated by something, though not a fear produced by another Path of Phobos power. Spend the usual Blood Trait and make a number of Simple Tests equal to six minus your target's Courage Traits; each test you win or tie yields one Fear Trait added to your blood pool. Fear Traits work exactly like Blood Traits, save that any left unspent vanish at sunrise. Retest with Intimidation.
